idiom noun

also idiomatic expression, idiomatic expressions, turn of phrase

classical

Traupman 331

proprietās linguae

idiom, what is peculiar to a language

Proprietās is a thing’s own peculiar quality (Cic., Lewis & Short); with linguae Latīnae or Anglicae, the idiom of a language.

Other words

  • figūra, figūrae f. — figure of speech, turn of phrase

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Traupman 331 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • quae linguae Latīnae (Anglicae) propria sunt

    idiomatic expressions (what is peculiar to Latin, to English)Traupman 331
